results.rationale: The braided plant, leaves and woven pot remain consistent. A pale green gradient, soft light patches and floating leaf silhouettes create the requested poster atmosphere, but distinct water droplets are absent and the upper-left cursive title overlaps foliage and is not cleanly readable as 'Green Home.' The plant renders naturally; the confused title is a noticeable layout and lettering flaw.

The cream trousers become uniformly light blue. Their silhouette, pleats, belt loops, button, hems and white background remain consistent. The edited garment has natural folds, clean edges and coherent fabric shading without noticeable artifacts.
